title: TenancyPartnerCreatedPayload
description: Payload of `tenancy.partner.created` version 1: a partner was created with the status `pending`, and its creator became its first owner (`tenancy.membership.created` is published alongside). The envelope's `partner_id` is the new partner. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner that was created, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

kind.description: Whether the partner is an organisation or an individual.

created_by.description: The user who created the partner and became its first owner.
